[[File:Premiere-D-nevaryalnal-decipher-archive.gif|thumb|right|260px|[[Nevar Yalnal]], one of the cards named after Raven.|link=Nevar Yalnal]]
'''Raven''' is the name of the dog of Decipher game designer [[Chuck Kallenbach]].<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
[[File:Hoth-D-blizzard2-decipher-archive.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Blizzard 2]] ([[Hoth Limited|Hoth]])|link=Blizzard 2]]
Two cards carry the name Nevar, which is Raven spelled backwards: the [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] card [[Nevar Yalnal]], and the [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] card [[Blizzard 2]], whose lore names its commander, "General Nevar".<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> Other titles scramble the names of Kallenbach's family: [[Chall Bekan]] and [[Imperial Helmsman]] (Bachenhall) from Kallenbach, and [[Chyler]] from his wife [[Cheryl Kallenbach|Cheryl]].<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
